name: list_gateways
summary: List the scopes device tools take as gateway_id: 'world' (every device), then each StationGod Gateway with its status: ready, incomplete or no_data_network. Read only.

help.text: Answers 'world' first (status bypass, every device in the world), then every StationGod Gateway in the loaded world with available and status. Only a ready gateway's id scopes a call; the others answer gateway_unavailable.
